questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{设}S_{n}&=\sum_{k=1}^{n}b\lambda^{k},\ \text{则}S_{n}=b\frac{(1-\lambda^{n})\lambda}{1-\lambda},\ \text{又由分布律的性质}\sum_{k=1}^{\infty}P\{X=k\}=\sum_{k=1}^{\infty}b\lambda^{k}=1\text{有}\\&\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}S_{n}=\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}b\lambda\frac{1-\lambda^{n}}{1-\lambda}=1.\\ \text{于是，当}|\lambda|<1\text{时，极限存在，且}b\frac{\lambda}{1-\lambda}=1\,.\\ \text{故}\lambda&=\frac{1}{1+b}(b>0)\,.\end{aligned}
